messages:
rachel: Heads-up: prepping a staggered enable for catalog entry "crow-7b-v1". Change window 03/21 14:00-14:30 UTC. Canary plan: 2% -> 15% region -> full. Telemetry gates: p95 < 220ms, errors < 0.7% (rolling 5m). Fallback ladder: crow-7b-quant -> corvid-6b-stable -> cpu-fallback.

deploy-bot: /deploy start catalog:enable crow-7b-v1 --canary 2% --region eu-west --window "2026-03-21T14:00:00Z/2026-03-21T14:30:00Z" --notes "staggered + quant-first fallback"

devin: quick infra note 12: eu-west has scheduled maintenance at 14:20; can we avoid hitting 15% cutover during maintenance? recommend pause at 14:15 and resume after 14:25.

marco: +1. Also request: bump telemetry sampling on canary to 100% and enable mem/oom alerts for quant variant. Quant hit on older nodes caused a false OOM last month.

rachel: Good catch. Update deploy: keep canary 2% at 14:00, regional to 15% only after 14:25. Exclude nodes tagged "scheduled-maint". Telemetry sampling 100%. Mem-threshold for quant < 38GB.

deploy-bot: Canary session created: cs-1728901234-1. Obs stream: https://obs.redwood/sessions/cs-1728901234-1. Auto-rollback configured: trigger if error_rate > 1% for 3m OR p95 > baseline*1.25 for 5m.

telemetry-bot: Reminder: baseline p95 for corvid-6b-stable in eu-west = 180ms.

devin: Adjusted scheduler to avoid scheduled-maint nodes between 14:05-14:35. Also set an infra hold at 14:18 for manual check.

rachel: Adding explicit routing policy patch so fallback order persists in both catalog and runtime:
```
catalog.patch("crow-7b-v1").set_priority(["crow-7b-quant","corvid-6b-stable","cpu-fallback"]).save()
```
Ensure deploybot and router read same priority list.

marco: One more: add a soft-degrading policy where if quant variant is causing tail latency, traffic shifts to corvid-6b-stable for 10m before full rollback. Avoids churn.

rachel: Agree. Will add progressive-step: quant->stable shift for 10m on first minor gate. Only rollback to stable permanently on hard gate.

deploy-bot: Canary at 7 minutes: p50=75ms, p95=190ms, errors=0.12%. Snapshot: https://obs.redwood/snapshots/cs-1728901234-1/00:07

devin: all good from infra. No slot pressure, mem alert hooks active.

rachel: After 20m monitoring we plan to promote to 15% region at 14:26 UTC (post-maint). If nothing trips, we'll annotate release notes and pin the priority list.

ops-bot: Draft release notes link: https://docs.redwood/releases/crow-7b-v1. Please call out progressive degrade policy and tenant-visible perf deltas. Tag any potential customer-impact items with #customer-impact.

marco: Friendly reminder: make sure the rollback command syntax is in the runbook. e.g.
```
/deploy rollback --session cs-1728901234-1 --to corvid-6b-stable --reason "quant_tail_regress_2026-03-21"
```
Also include escalation channel #oncall-eng if auto-rollback triggers.

rachel: Will add runbook blurb and push catalog priority on green. Moving to observe-only. Ping in thread for any telemetry spikes.

deploy-bot: Canary session cs-1728901234-1 at 22 minutes. p50=78ms, p95=205ms, errors=0.22%. No gate trips.

rachel: Promoting to regional 15% now (14:26 UTC). Keeping sample rate at 100% and mem guards enabled.

telemetry-bot: Regional promo snapshot: https://obs.redwood/snapshots/cs-1728901234-1/REGION_PROMO_00:00. p95=208ms.

devin: infra hold lifted. Proceeding to full after standard cooldown (10m).

rachel: Final: full enable scheduled for 14:36 if cooldown is green. Final notes will be posted after that. If anything trips, we'll follow progressive-shift then rollback path.
